verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents point-in-time recovery that 'rolls you back to any moment' so an accidental drop can be recovered, a 'time travel' feature that restores the database to an earlier point, and automated daily backups with a recovery model. That covers the restore half of the story. There is no evidence of querying data as of a past timestamp without restoring, and recovery is described only at database level, not per table. missing for 10: query-as-of-past-point syntax or read-only historical queries, per-table restore granularity, retention-window details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
